title: T030 versioned gRPC/Protocol Buffers tool API and additive evolution rules

scope.intended_use: Define the versioned capability-007 external-tool contract at proto/xverse/xcom/v1/tool_gateway.proto with additive evolution rules, generate the C++ contract artifacts with the T011-admitted tools, and prove the contract with offline generated-contract tests.
boundaries: Bounded capability-007 prototype scope: one committed schema, one generated-message library, and additive offline generated-contract tests.
No gateway server, IPC listener, socket, separate process, compiled/linked gRPC runtime, external peer, or production workload.
T030 changes are limited to the new contract artifact, the additive build wiring, the new tests, the T030 work products, the engineering trace records, and the inherited provenance refresh.
success_criteria: Every accepted T030 software requirement is traced to the applicable X-Verse system anchor, component, unit, code, unit/integration/validation tests and measured evidence.
The four generated-contract suites and the preserved platform suites pass in the offline admitted build.
Independent review and strict delivery validation bind the exact candidate before acceptance.

reliability.basis: Deterministic offline generated-contract tests over the generated descriptor plus the preserved platform suites, in the admitted X-COM build envelope.

authority.decision_rule: Any conflict with the accepted capability-007 specification, constitution, accepted ADRs, T007 ownership register, T008 requirement register, T009 architecture model, or the accepted T010 unit design is resolved in favour of the accepted source; material gaps are recorded, not guessed. The new proto/xverse/xcom/v1/tool_gateway.proto path did not exist at the baseline, so authoring it changes no accepted predecessor byte.

verification_profile_note: Trusted policy requires explicit unit, static, validation, and target-repository integration measures for the T030 contract slice.
